bondingCurveDaiReserves().details: Fully off-grid: no oracle, no relayer, no caller-supplied value. Falls back to      `totalDaiCollected()` and finally to zero, so the unlock always fails closed rather      than open if the token's interface is ever unavailable.

returns._0: The curve's DAI reserves, in DAI wei.

checkAndUnlockVault().details: Permissionless and argument-free by design. Not even the orchestrator can unlock an      under-funded curve, because there is no value for a caller to supply.

checkProjectTimeout(uint256).details: Permissionless. Unspent OBS returns to the vault; it is never destroyed and never      becomes withdrawable outside the milestone path.

commissionRoomieRobot(bytes32,address,by.details: Biometric templates stay hard-locked on the MCU and are never part of this call.      May be re-run to rotate the credential until {revokeAndUpdateImmutability}.

params.mcuEcdsaSigner: secp256k1 address derived inside the MCU secure element.
params.otsChainLength: Number of authorizations the chain can serve. This is a hard                         ceiling on how many releases the credential can ever approve.
params.otsChainTip: s_N, where s_i = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(s_{i-1})) and the MCU                         alone holds the seed s_0.
params.pqcPublicKeyHash: keccak256 of the MCU's full PQC public key.

completeProject(uint256).details: Requires every scheduled milestone to have been delivered and the cumulative mission      ledger to show real acreage, hives, free honey, water, solar and battery. Any      unspent allocation returns to the vault.

constructor.details: Zero-config by design: deployment takes no arguments and performs no setup.

createOffGridBeeHabitatProposal(string,u.details: Requires 50 unexpired LP. Every hardcoded mission rule is checked here and again at      each fund release. The funding amount and payout recipient are fixed now and cannot      be chosen later at execution time.

params.payoutRecipient: The only address this project can ever pay.
params.proposedBeePopulationIndex: Target bee population index, capped for safety.
params.targetAcresForBees: Flowering acreage the habitat will forage.

depositToVault(uint256).details: Credits the balance actually received, so a fee-on-transfer or rebasing OBS cannot      desynchronise internal accounting from the token balance.

params.amount: OBS to pull from the caller. Requires prior approval.

executeProposal(uint256).details: Permissionless: the funding amount and recipient come from the proposal the DAO      voted on, so an executor has nothing left to choose. The spend is stretched over      max(MIN_PROJECT_MILESTONES, ceil(funding / trancheCeiling)) tranches of 60 days.

issueMonthlyLpTokens(address,uint256).details: The 100 LP ceiling is cumulative per member per month, not per call. Unused LP      expires at the epoch boundary and is never carried forward.

revokeAndUpdateImmutability().details: After this call the PQC public key, MCU signer and OTS chain can never be changed      again by anyone, the orchestrator included. Governance, releases and completion      continue to operate under the now-permanent credential.      Ordering matters: revoking before {commissionRoomieRobot} permanently prevents every      fund release, because the commissioned flag can no longer be set.

robotAuthorizeAndReleaseMilestone(uint25.details: Every one of the following must hold:      - the bonding curve has genuinely collected 5,000,000,000 DAI;      - the Roomie robot MCU is commissioned;      - at most one authorization per project per 60 days;      - a valid hybrid PQC and ECDSA authorization from the MCU, which verifies the        operator's biometrics locally before signing;      - the hardcoded mission rules are attested as happening in the real world;      - the tranche is within both the project's per-milestone cap and its anti-dump        tranche ceiling.      Funds go only to the payout recipient the DAO voted on. There is no arbitrary      recipient anywhere in this contract. Checks-Effects-Interactions is observed: the      token transfer is the final statement.

params.attestation: The robot's real-world evidence for this tranche.
params.mcuEcdsaSignature: The MCU's 65-byte secp256k1 signature over the hybrid digest.
params.otsPreimage: The next link of the MCU's one-time-signature hash chain.
params.pqcPublicKey: The MCU's full PQC public key.
params.pqcSignature: The MCU's full PQC signature over the authorization.

setupRoomieRobotAndLock(bytes32).details: Provisional only. It deliberately does NOT enable spending; that requires      {commissionRoomieRobot} with the real MCU credential.

params.pqcPublicKeyHash: keccak256 of the placeholder or real PQC public key.

syncVault().details: Permissionless. Donations can only ever increase the vault.

params.newPqcPublicKeyHash: keccak256 of the replacement PQC public key.

params.support: True to vote for, false against.

ADMIN_ORCHESTRATOR().notice: The only wallet that may provision, rotate or freeze the Roomie robot credential         and drive operations. Hardcoded; it cannot be transferred or renounced.

BONDING_CURVE_DAI_UNLOCK_TARGET().notice: 5 billion DAI (18 decimals) of real bonding-curve reserves unlocks the vault.

HABITAT_FOCUS_ZONE().notice: Geographic mandate for every funded habitat.

LP_EPOCH().notice: LP expires at the end of each epoch and is never carried forward.

MAX_PROJECT_BPS_OF_VAULT().notice: No single project may reserve more than 20% of the unreserved vault.

MAX_TRANCHE_BPS_OF_VAULT().notice: No single 60-day tranche may exceed 2.5% of the vault balance at approval time.

MILESTONE_GATING_INTERVAL().notice: The robot may authorize a given project once every 60 days.

MILESTONE_TYPEHASH().notice: Domain separator for a milestone authorization signed by the Roomie MCU.

MIN_FLOWERING_ACRES_TARGET().notice: Minimum flowering acreage any funded habitat must forage.

MIN_PQC_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES().notice: Minimum PQC public key size. SPHINCS+ public keys are only 32 bytes.

MIN_PQC_SIGNATURE_BYTES().notice: Minimum PQC signature size, chosen to reject classically-sized signatures.

MIN_PROJECT_MILESTONES().notice: Every project is stretched over at least six tranches, so at least twelve months.

MISSION_MANDATE().notice: The mission the robots are bound to. Enforced by code, not convention.

MONTHLY_LP_ISSUANCE().notice: 100 LP per member per month, cumulative across all issuances in that month.

OBS_TOKEN().notice: Obscura (OBS) on Arbitrum One. Verified: name "Obscura", symbol "OBS", 18 decimals.

OPTIMAL_BEE_INDEX_CAP().notice: Safe carrying-capacity ceiling for the bee population index.

PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD().notice: 50 unexpired LP are required to open a proposal.

QUORUM_PERCENTAGE().notice: Percentage of the epoch's live LP supply that must vote for a proposal to pass.

TARGET_BEE_FLOURISHING_INDEX().notice: Global flourishing target. Operations continue indefinitely until it is met.

availableVaultBalance().notice: Vault OBS not already committed to a live project.

beeFlourishingIndex().notice: Cumulative, robot-attested bee flourishing index across all projects.

bondingCurveDaiReserves().notice: Reads the OBS bonding-curve DAI reserves directly from the OBS token contract.

canUpdateRobotConfig().notice: False once {revokeAndUpdateImmutability} is signed. It never returns to true.

checkAndUnlockVault().notice: Unlocks the vault once the curve genuinely holds 5,000,000,000 DAI.

checkProjectTimeout(uint256).notice: Expires a project that has run past its deadline.

commissionRoomieRobot(bytes32,address,by.notice: Binds the real credential once the Roomie robot and its hybrid PQC MCU arrive.

completeProject(uint256).notice: Closes a project once the entirety of it is done.

createOffGridBeeHabitatProposal(string,u.notice: Opens a funding proposal for an off-grid indoor bee habitat.

executeProposal(uint256).notice: Executes a passed proposal into a funded, time-locked project.

getMissionLedger(uint256).notice: Cumulative real-world delivery attested for a project.

getTotalActiveLpSupply().notice: Live, unexpired LP supply. This is the quorum denominator.

getVaultBalance().notice: The vault's live OBS token balance.

getVotingPower(address).notice: One LP is one vote. Returns zero once the LP has expired.

issueMonthlyLpTokens(address,uint256).notice: Issues expiring LP to a member.

lpSupplyByEpoch(uint256).notice: Live LP issued per epoch. This is the quorum denominator.

nextMilestoneUnlockTime(uint256).notice: The next timestamp at which the robot may authorize this project again.

obsToken().notice: The OBS token this vault holds.

revokeAndUpdateImmutability().notice: FINAL AND IRREVERSIBLE. Freezes the robot configuration forever.

robotAuthorizeAndReleaseMilestone(uint25.notice: The single path by which OBS can ever leave this vault.

setupRoomieRobotAndLock(bytes32).notice: Anchors the Roomie robot slot with a provisional PQC public-key commitment.         Callable the moment the contract exists.

syncVault().notice: Credits OBS that was sent to the vault by a plain `transfer`.

totalObsReleased().notice: OBS released to habitat operators to date.

totalReservedForProjects().notice: OBS committed to live projects and therefore unavailable to new ones.

updateRobotPqcPublicKey(bytes32).notice: Rotates only the PQC public-key commitment, for an MCU firmware or key refresh.

vaultUnlocked().notice: Set once by {checkAndUnlockVault}. One-way; it can never be unset.

vote(uint256,bool).notice: Casts a vote weighted one-to-one by the caller's unexpired LP.
